crossRefs.note: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.
He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.
God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made…
Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether…
He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his…
“Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all…

translations.web: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
translations.bsb: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
translations.kjv: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
translations.asv: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
